description: Use this when the user wants FlareWarden to watch the TLS certificate of a subdomain it found under a site (from public certificate logs), or to stop. Returns the subdomain's tracking state and, when tracking starts, its certificate's issuer and expiry. A tracked subdomain gets a daily certificate check and expiry alerts, at no cost to the plan. Not for checking the subdomain itself is up: plan it as a site with plan_site.

site.description: The site the subdomain was found under, by id, name or part of its URL.

subdomain.description: The subdomain, such as api.acme.com, or its id.

tracked.description: False to stop tracking; true by default.

name: track_subdomain_certificate
title: Track a subdomain's certificate
